'''2018 US Nationals Phillip Gladney LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Phillip Gladney]] at [[2018 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Phillip Gladney]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (location)|Hoth-L-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open EBO Gladney LS 2018 Nats.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141216/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ Internet Archive]
